title: AnimationSpy
features:
🎞️ Animation Spy GUI Features

    👤 LocalPlayer Only: Tracks animations played exclusively by your character

    🆔 Animation List: Shows animation names and IDs in a scrollable list

    📋 Copy ID: Click on any animation ID to copy it to your clipboard instantly

    ▶️ Play Animation: Preview animations on your character with a convenient play button

    🖱️ Draggable Window: Move the GUI by dragging the top bar (only when holding left-click)

    ↔️ Resizable UI: Resize the window using the bottom-right corner grip for better visibility

    ⬆️ Toggle Visibility: Show or hide the entire GUI by pressing the Right Shift key

    🛠️ Open-Source: Fully customizable and easy to integrate into your projects
